title: Lock or Unlock Knox Lock/Box
description: Use this service request to request to have a Knox Company emergency lock or box opened or locked by Dallas Fire personnel. The estimated response time for this service request is 3 business days.

observedQuestions.question: What is the occupancy location type?
If this is a business, what is the name of the business/facility?
How many stories are in the building?
Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

detailsForm.completedContactPath: Occupancy = Storage/warehouse/parking garage; business name and stories supplied; contact = No; Details Continue reached Contact
detailsForm.contactStepObservation: First Name, Last Name, and Phone Number marked required

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for Dallas Fire personnel to open or lock a Knox Company emergency lock or box.
actions.why: To request Dallas Fire personnel to open or lock a Knox Company emergency lock or box. The request form asks for the occupancy type, business or facility name when relevant, and building story count.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Non-Emergency Police and Fire Services" > Choose "Lock or Unlock Knox Lock/Box"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Non-Emergency Police and Fire Services" > Choose "Lock or Unlock Knox Lock/Box"
